detail: looking at it, the game names it "Sealed Spring", locked (Novice)
the water-carrier Ruxa-Neel and the sap-seller Wujeel speak of it
its door shows "Tree-Minders' Hall"
the healer Taleeka-Ma heals and sells spell tomes there, and she and the sap-seller Wujeel both name it and its leader
she is seen clearing creepers from tree roots
the healers' leader calls her the root-tender at the door; the elder Hixee-Ra speaks first and says who she is
its door shows "The Council House of the Xeech-Leel"; inside, an iron door shows "Council Strongroom" (Master lock); the house behind shows "Council Wardens' Quarters"
its door shows "Nesh-Deeka's House"
Nesh-Deeka heads the household and lives there; Never-Writes-Twice keeps a bed in it
its door shows "Boatmen's Lodge"
the innkeeper Sleeps-Last keeps it and rents its bed
its door shows "Tree-Minders' Hall"; inside, the case names itself "Urn Case", locked (Expert)
the raft-master Poles-Upriver works the city landing
the world map marks "Rootworm Landing (Helstrom)" beside the mud mouth
the great city tree over the market by the landing, and the rootworm's mud mouth among its roots on its south-west side, apart from the tree's amber sap pool
the root-tender Cheeval-Xu works at the pool's edge and sells the rootworm's rides
its door, at the back of the Market Cave, shows "Ruusa-Wan's House"
two lanterns on the sill by the door
its door shows Vosh-Leera's House
Vosh-Leera heads its household and is home there; Weeltul sends the player back to her house
looking at the moss, the game names it "Hanging Moss" and lets it be picked
a woven weir of four Saxhleel fences across the creek's narrow head, with a cypress log walk along its top and long grey moss draped on both faces of its fences
Black Marsh & Valenwood's Imperial ship moored along the camp's bank, masts up, its hold door in the waist, a jetty and two planks over its rail to the bank
in the Gang-Master's Hut, beside his hammock
the game shows "Dralin's Strongbox" on it
a young Hist some 6 m tall on the camp's west side, plank walkways round its foot, its amber sap pool round its roots
Heem-Jasa, the tree's minder, works on the walkway by its sap pool all day
the game names it a Knapsack, lying with the jars at the hide (a container of ours keeps its base's name)
a scale-hide lean-to on the west bank, beside a tall lone dead swamp tree, with a crate, two clay jars and a knapsack beside it
the same young Hist dead, grey and leafless, in the living tree's place
Skyrim's long metal cage, with bars all round and a roof, at the camp's west edge on the creek side; it stands some 1,850 units from the fire by the longhouse
Sesk inside it; Jeeta-Sakka, who carries its key, stands at the fire by the longhouse with the other guards
glazed urns stacked against the longhouse wall beside its door
the longhouse door shows the household's name, and the cellar "Karsh-Naal Cellar"
